auth_details: public.api.bsky.app is unauthenticated public-read only (AppView). Authenticated XRPC (createSession, writes, private data) go to the user's PDS or Bluesky entryway (bsky.social) with session JWT (app password) or OAuth; Authorization: Bearer <accessJwt>.
rate_limits: Public AppView (api.bsky.app / public.api.bsky.app): generous limits, no published general numeric cap—contact Bluesky if hit. Hosted PDS (by IP): 3,000 req/5 min overall; createSession 30/5 min and 300/day per account; stricter on some writes—see docs.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor right.
